caption: The video captures a close, slightly high-angle view of a glossy white ceramic vessel shaped like an inverted pig, its circular rim flecked with chipped dark marks and a small spout protruding on the right. Within the opening, a pool of translucent amber liquid holds a pale rectangular block that is already partly submerged. Over time the block sinks steadily lower into the liquid, its bright upper face descending toward the surface as the amber line climbs up its front. Meanwhile the vessel itself, the scattered brown stains, the white electrical outlet at the lower left, and the soft shadow on the left all remain fixed. The camera holds a steady view, and the lighting and reflections on the ceramic stay constant. No bubbling or other disturbance is visible in the liquid, and the slow submersion continues without reaching a settled state.
